name: card-drift
title: Card Drift
description: Draggable card grid with physics-based throw, velocity tracking, auto-layout, and GSAP Draggable

changelog.summary: Added data, bgColor, bgTextColor, cardBg, cardTextColor, and barBg as public props with a working remixer panel. The originally suggested props (driftAmount, rotationAmount, duration, shadowOpacity) described ambient hover drift, but this component is a drag-and-throw physics grid with fixed jitter/rotation constants, so they were replaced with the content/theme props CardDriftComp actually accepts.
Added a prefers-reduced-motion notice explaining that dragging stays fully interactive since it is a direct, user-initiated action.
